swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): At the State level, the legislature is usually a single House. Reason (R): Fig. 10.5 states that most States have a single assembly, while only a few States have two. Choose the correct option.

add.q: Assertion (A): At the national level, the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha together formulate laws for the whole country. Reason (R): Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam served as the 11th President of India from 2002 to 2007. Choose the correct option.

o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true, R is false
